checkpoints.description: [1/1] Plan: one type scale in theme.css, every font-size becomes a token

impact_assessment.why: G-008 asks for type from theme tokens and the file used 15 raw sizes between 9.5 and 22 px
impact_assessment.benefits: Six sizes to reason about and one place to change them
impact_assessment.risks: contract: UI only, 1 file 89 lines; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: none
impact_assessment.mitigation: Sizes move by at most one pixel, every panel at three widths plus the live and approval states compared pixel by pixel and by eye

handoff.state: type scale applied and reviewed by the agent under G-010
handoff.next: finish the UI task and commit then tokenise spacing
handoff.evidence: 82 font-size declarations now use 7 tokens and none stay raw, all 32 stock panel pairs and the 6 live and approval state pairs have identical dimensions with 0.5 to 5.4 percent of pixels differing from text re-rendering, I inspected the Settings pair at 390 and the approval pair at 390 and saw no clipping or overlap and unchanged contrast, header title 15 to 14 px the only visible shift

checkpoints.description: [1/1] Plan: a unit test that every var(--x) in theme.css is defined

impact_assessment.why: A token refactor nearly shipped undefined variables that fail silently and loosened every form
impact_assessment.benefits: A missing or renamed token fails a test with its name and line
impact_assessment.risks: contract: test only; dependency: reads src/theme.css; concurrency: none; state: none
impact_assessment.mitigation: Mutation-checked: an undefined var fails with the name and line

handoff.next: redo the spacing and radius tokens against a renumbered scale in bounded UI tasks
handoff.evidence: test passes on the real stylesheet and fails with name and line on a mutant, 12 of 12 gates

checkpoints.description: [1/3] Plan: spacing scale and radius tokens, step one covers every gap and border-radius

impact_assessment.why: G-008 asks for spacing from theme tokens and the sheet set 66 gaps and 19 radii by hand
impact_assessment.benefits: One spacing scale and radius set that later steps apply to padding and margin
impact_assessment.risks: contract: UI only, 1 file about 200 lines; dependency: renumbers the unused-once --space-1..5; concurrency: none; state: none
impact_assessment.mitigation: A new test fails on any undefined variable, every panel at three widths plus states compared pixel by pixel and by eye

handoff.state: gap and radius tokenised and reviewed by the agent under G-010
handoff.next: finish then commit then padding and then margin and colours
handoff.evidence: my first attempt skipped defining new tokens because the sheet already had a different --space-1 to 5 and the before and after pair showed the Settings form 14 px looser per field so I reverted and added a test for undefined variables then redid it with the old scale renumbered, final pairs differ by at most 4.6 percent of pixels with identical dimensions and the Settings pair at 390 shows the same density within 1 px per field, 66 spacing and 19 radius values tokenised none raw remain

checkpoints.description: [2/3] Plan: spacing scale applied to every padding declaration

impact_assessment.why: G-008 asks for spacing from theme tokens and the sheet set 99 paddings by hand
impact_assessment.benefits: Padding follows the same scale as gap
impact_assessment.risks: contract: UI only, 1 file 176 lines; dependency: tokens from the previous step; concurrency: none; state: none
impact_assessment.mitigation: Guard test for undefined variables, every panel at three widths plus states compared pixel by pixel and by eye

handoff.state: padding tokenised and reviewed by the agent under G-010
handoff.next: finish then commit then margin and colours
handoff.open: History cards touch with no gap which predates this change
handoff.evidence: 160 values tokenised none raw remain, guard test passes, 38 pairs have identical dimensions with up to 10.6 percent of pixels differing, I inspected Settings and History at 390 and saw cards inset 2 px more and fields about 2 px looser with no clipping or overlap and unchanged contrast

checkpoints.description: [3/3] Plan: spacing scale applied to every margin and one theme-aware on-accent text colour

impact_assessment.why: G-008 asks for spacing and colours from theme tokens and the sheet set 31 margins and 3 text colours by hand, one of them white on a light accent
impact_assessment.benefits: Margins follow the scale and text on an accent surface reads well in both themes
impact_assessment.risks: contract: UI only, 1 file 47 lines; dependency: tokens from the earlier steps; concurrency: none; state: none
impact_assessment.mitigation: Guard test for undefined variables, panels and states at three widths plus light theme pairs, zoomed comparison of the affected controls

handoff.state: margin and on-accent tokenised and reviewed by the agent under G-010
handoff.open: History cards touch with no gap and disabled Send text is fainter on the light theme
handoff.evidence: no raw margin or text hex remains, guard test passes, 38 dark pairs and 9 light pairs have identical dimensions with at most 3.5 percent of pixels differing, a zoomed before and after montage showed Add provider and the brand mark go from dark to white text on the light theme with contrast about 4.0 to 4.8 to 1 and the dark theme send button unchanged, nothing clipped or overlapping

checkpoints.description: [1/1] Plan: links and diff summaries get the app focus ring

impact_assessment.why: G-004 asks for keyboard gates and G-008 for one visual grammar with a visible focus state, and links and the diff summary showed the browser default near-black ring on a near-black theme
impact_assessment.benefits: A keyboard user can see where focus is on every focusable element
impact_assessment.risks: contract: UI only, 1 file 2 lines; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: none
impact_assessment.mitigation: Computed outline measured before and after at three widths, focused states screenshotted and zoomed, all panels compared

handoff.state: focus ring fix reviewed by the agent under G-010
handoff.open: History cards touch with no gap and Firefox and WebKit are not tested
handoff.evidence: computed outline went from auto 1px rgb 16 16 16 to solid 2px accent for the link and the diff summary at 390 768 and 1440, the before shots showed an almost invisible dark rectangle and the after shots a clear accent ring in the same style as other controls, skip link dark text on accent is legible, 27 of 32 stock panel pairs are pixel identical and the other 5 differ only by live data since the same tree run twice also differs on 3 of them
